conventions.cycle_0: first model cycle; the WalkConfig/LFSMInstructionConfig pair is accepted at the commit of the cycle marked by out.cfg (cycle 0 for inst 0). o_lfsm_idle before cycle 0 is 1 by construction.
conventions.fire_timing: mem_req / ptr_upd / reg_req entries are golden grant/fire-cycle events. RTL replay aligns chain heads with a constant +2 cycle shift (edge-3 strict pipeline +1, A-014 send stage +1) and compares per-request metadata and order, not raw cycle numbers (TEST_PLAN §0.4, GAP-06/07).
conventions.query_idle: out.query[lane] mirrors o_load_range_query_{valid,base,advance}; in.idle[lane] is the Buf/RAM same-cycle answer i_load_range_idle (forced 1 when query valid=0, A-004).
conventions.reg_req: C-only RegisterRequest fire events; the RTL port holds head-valid until fire (o_reg_req_valid && i_register_ready), TB mirrors the FIFO for hold checks.
conventions.occupancy: pend = probe B pending_mem_owners[lane] (in-flight owners, RDQ depth basis, A-002); rdq/blk/asmp/wins/held = probe A structural readings (burst artifacts, not depth basis).
